description: Tool node: encrypted file storage for agents. Agents /connect with a throwaway public key, unlock their seat with a single-use voucher, then list/store/retrieve/delete files; every message after /connect is sealed to the vault's key and every reply is sealed and signed. Register with `a8s add vault ~/vault-seat tool-vault`; then `python3 <ar3>/apps/tools/vault init --node vault` and `voucher issue <name>` for each sender. Every sender is served under its own section, keyed by its name, and needs an operator-issued voucher to authenticate. The key and store live in `${XDG_DATA_HOME:-~/.local/share}/ar3/vault/<node>/`; optional var VAULT_DIR moves them. Optional var OPENSSL names the openssl binary. See docs/a8s-tools.md.
